title.narrative: Programme Operations and Technical Assistance to the Government of Nepal on Post Earthquake Reconstruction Planning

description.narrative: This activity Programme Operations and Technical Assistance to the Government of Nepal on Post Earthquake Reconstruction Planning is a component of Post-Earthquake Reconstruction in Nepal - Building Back Better reported by FCDO with a funding type of 104 - Procurement of Services and a budget of £2,600,943. It works in the following sector(s): Immediate post-emergency reconstruction and rehabilitation.
